name: 02_context_allocation_alerts
origin: A reviewer's memory test case (three parts), re-expressed for the agreed design: the agent sees ranked headers and decides

memories.title: Context allocation too large for local model
memories.body: Allocated context exceeded what the local model could hold; the run exhausted context. Size local allocation to the real window.

memories.title: Context allocation stale after driver change
memories.body: The API model inherited the small local allocation and ran out of context. Allocation is per model; reset it when the driver changes.

memories.title: Untested credential before delegation
memories.body: First call failed: the API key was wrong and untested. Probe the key before multi-round work.

steps.note: Planning a mixed local+API delegation: the two allocation alerts must outrank the credential alert, which matches only one tag.
When the task is about credentials, M3 leads.
